title: Concept: Python http.server directory listing exposed
description: A Python standard-library server renders a directory index. The listing exposes file names, sizes and timestamps for the whole directory, and directories served this way often contain source archives and editor backups that were never meant to be fetched.
applicability: Python http.server or SimpleHTTPServer deployments reachable from untrusted networks.
risk: Directory contents enumerable by any requester; MEDIUM severity.
